item: Winter wheat 2025 plots with no yield recorded (blank template in the raw workbook)
handling: Excluded; winter wheat 2025 is absent from all yield results

item: Ryegrass 2025 duplicate placeholder rows without data
handling: Dropped (one real record per plot remains)

item: Grass-clover 2025 plots without cut 1 (strip A1, nests N1-N6)
handling: Plots excluded from annual totals (incomplete season); strip A4 only for GC 2025

item: Suction-cup samples with no concentration value
handling: Not used in concentration summaries; the DL method interpolates linearly between valid samples

item: Suction-cup samples flagged below detection limit
handling: Kept at the value stored by the pipeline (not set to zero)

item: Records missing a measurement-year field (date recovered from file name)
handling: Date taken from the ddmmyy in the file name for all records

item: Date x nest x plot x probe combinations recorded in more than one file (crop-labelled copies)
handling: Averaged to one value per combination; sensitivity check using first record only is in tbl_tdr_overall

item: Water-content values above 45 vol-% (near saturation for this sandy soil)
handling: Retained (physically possible when wet); flagged only
